text: つきのいし　ないなあ…　きみの　ほうは　みつかった？

structure.jp: つきのいし　ないなあ…

patterns.name: 〜のほう
patterns.explanation: のほう after a person means 'that person's side', setting them against someone else. きみの　ほうは = 'how about on your end'.

patterns.name: 〜なあ
patterns.explanation: なあ at the end is a sigh said half to yourself. ないなあ = 'there just isn't one, huh'.
